# Dashboard Copy Notes

This note collects filler wording for a dashboard redesign.

The page should feel operational but friendly. Use short headlines, compact stat cards, and subtle helper text. Avoid heavy gradients and marketing-style slogans.

The web dashboard also needs a note about headers and browser restrictions, but this document does not define a real content security policy.

This document intentionally mentions exports, reports, and controls in a generic way, but it does not define backup policy, payroll readiness, or incident response steps.
